payload.message: Use the freebie-hunter skill as collector. Read state/freebie-hunter/config.json first. If not configured, ask for the city or a copied Kleinanzeigen 'Zu verschenken' search URL and stop. Otherwise fetch configured search pages with web_fetch, upsert real listings into state/freebie-hunter/listings.json, and regenerate reports/freebie-hunter-report.md.

Use the freebie-hunter and freebie-evaluator skills. Evaluate only listings with needsEvaluation=true, preserve outreach data, update state/freebie-hunter/listings.json, and regenerate reports/freebie-hunter-report.md. End with active listings scored >= 40 sorted descending.

Use the freebie-hunter skill as outreach drafter. Process only manually selected queue entries from state/freebie-hunter/outreach-queue.json. Open listing pages with browser if available, draft a message, never click final send, then update listings and queue state.
